title: Kaiser nurses say AI, workplace surveillance are making their jobs, care worse
ai_summary:

• Over-reliance on AI hinders human interaction and judgment in patient care decisions.
• Surveillance technology in the workplace creates anxiety and decreased job satisfaction.

title: AWS: Inaccurate Estimated Billing Data – $1.7 billion
ai_summary:

• Errors were caused by misconfigured billing and data inaccuracies on AWS' side, not user error.
• Users may now have the option to review their previous bills to assess potential losses.

title: The Zilog Z80 has turned 50
ai_summary:
• The Zilog Z80, a widely used microprocessor in the 1970s and 1980s, has turned 50 years old.
• It was first released in 1976 and found in various home computers, such as the Sinclair ZX80.
• The Z80's impact on the development of early personal computers cannot be overstated.

title: First atmosphere found on Earth-like planet in habitable zone of distant star
ai_summary:
• Astronomers discover an atmosphere on a distant Earth-like planet in habitable zone of a star.
• This discovery fuels hopes of finding extraterrestrial life and expands our knowledge of planetary formation.
• Researchers used advanced spectroscopic techniques to detect the atmospheric gases.
student_angle: Learn about advanced spectroscopic techniques to enhance your understanding of data analysis in astronomy.

title: Moonstone: Modern, cross-platform Lua runtime and package manager written in Zig
ai_summary:
• Moonstone is a modern, cross-platform Lua runtime and package manager written in Zig.
• It supports multiple platforms, including Windows, macOS, and Linux.
• Moonstone is designed for speed and scalability with a small binary size.
student_angle: Worth learning for those interested in embedded systems and low-level programming.

title: TP-Link Kasa cameras leaked home GPS via unauthenticated UDP for 6 years
ai_summary:
• TP-Link Kasa smart cameras leaked home GPS coordinates through unauthenticated UDP for six years.
• Vulnerability was discovered, and TP-Link responded by providing fixes and security patches.
• Issue exposed homes to potential tracking and unauthorized access.
student_angle: None, this is a cautionary tale highlighting potential security risks in IoT devices.

title: I Started a "Dirt Notebook"
ai_summary:

• The "Dirt Notebook" is a simple, low-cost alternative to digital tools for data tracking.

title: Learning a few things about running SQLite
ai_summary:
• SQLite is a lightweight, serverless, self-contained database management system for local storage.
• SQLite is widely used in applications and frameworks that require a robust database solution.
• SQLite supports SQL syntax, transactions, views, and triggers for complex queries and data manipulation.
student_angle: Learning SQLite is worth your time, as its versatility and ease of use make it a valuable skill for software development careers.
